'''May 2001 Berlin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Berlin, Germany on 12 May 2001. [[Ralf Blobelt]] won it. It is known from Alexander Schwarz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2319">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-17-berlin-germany-05-12-01aka-the-returnd2319/ berlin-germany-05-12-01aka-the-return], DeckTech (Alexander "Black Leader" Schwarz, 17 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-17-berlin-germany-05-12-01aka-the-returnd2319/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Berlin, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Ralf Blobelt]]
